protocol.stage: Contained-backend diagnostic replication, NOT E3 acceptance
protocol.relative_rule: Compare each fixed configuration with native-default in the same diagnostic block.
protocol.stop_rule: Complete all 3 predeclared diagnostic blocks even after practical failure; stop on acquisition/code error and diagnose. Never proceed E4 on failure.
protocol.data_role: Exploratory configuration comparison on reused V102 sequence; independent processes, not independent scenes or final holdout
protocol.clock_uncertainty: deadline equality uses recorded integer ns; no proved clock uncertainty bound
protocol.scope: Cold-start at offset20 failed for both controls and is retained as a real limitation. This profile examines continuous operation from recorded sequence origin.
protocol.full_run_rule: All 1600 frames remain in validity, reset, latency, CPU, memory and accounting gates. No outcome-dependent filtering.
protocol.quality_interval_rule: Reference positions unavailable at raw beginning: fixed k in [20,1600) for SE3 ATE/GT coverage; original 99% valid-pose gate additionally applies to all 1600 frames.
protocol.history_rule: Start visual/map processing at sequence origin, preserve real map updates and timing throughout. First and second halves are dependent subsegments, not independent replicates.
protocol.timing_rule: All 1600 frames including GBA backlog; h=tau=50ms; no frame removal or post-hoc deadline change
protocol.random_seed: No new RNG override; upstream randomization and OS scheduling remain. Distinct processes only.
protocol.revision: v2 after lifecycle bug fix; all comparisons restart with the new library; aborted batch retained
